slides.heading: Worth an assessment if

caption:
Sore right in the sit bone every time you sit? Toto's answer was to stretch harder. That can backfire.

The hamstring tendons attach to your sit bone. Deep stretching and long sitting can press the tendon against the bone and keep it sensitive.

What usually helps: pausing deep hamstring stretches for a few weeks, firmer chairs, getting up every 30 minutes, and gradual strength work that starts with simple holds like a 30-second bridge, 5 times.

A sudden pop, bruising or tingling down the leg is worth checking soon. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can guide a loading plan. Book online via the link in bio 🐰
